question: What benefit of granting the four aims of life is attributed to the supreme brahmāstra knowledge?
premises: The verse refers to the knowledge of the supreme brahmāstra.
This knowledge is described as giving the fruit of the four aims.
The four aims are presented as its result.
inference: The supreme brahmāstra knowledge is characterized as bestowing the fruits of the four human aims.
uncertainties: syntactic connection to previous verse is implied
plain_english: It belongs to the knowledge of the supreme brahmāstra and grants the fruit of the four aims of life.
